Native DIV Data Model and IDL

original_source_items.meaning: System/Subsystem is a context-relative relation, not a universal chassis
Sensor is a device or system, but whole-System Details scope extends beyond estimating external properties
Module functional architecture can be hardware/software and differs from Hardware Element
Platform denotes device, host vehicle or computing infrastructure and must be qualified
Health, Status, State, Mode, Capability, Configuration have distinct meaning
Detection, Audit Event, Notification, Heartbeat, Logging and Relay Event distinct
Data Products raw/minimal vs Information Products processed
Compliance differs from Conformance; separate Test/Inspection/Analysis/Demonstration methods
Appendix A glossary references Table13.5.3.3.3-1, unusual within Appendix A; preserve printed ID
Appendix B is Normative but names eight original native files; filenames are not file content
TechStd_v1 filenames in C239 Ed1.1 do not verify matching native file revision

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Described sensing System / arrangement
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Source System is elements forming useful capability and can be a Subsystem depending on context; Sensor may be device or System
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No universal chassis, one hierarchy or adopted DIM superclass

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Observer / observing System
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Sensor estimates properties of another entity and produces quantitative data
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not every installed source constituent is an observing system

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Physical constituent
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Element can be hardware/software/logical while Hardware Element is physical hardware incorporated in sensor
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No automatic individually identified System or mixing software with equipment

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Hosting platform / station context
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Platform can mean supported sensing device, vehicle host or computing infrastructure; Pod may carry components of multiple sensors
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Platform role must be qualified, no generic chassis

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Connected external equipment
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Platform can mean vehicle host or computing infrastructure; Interface defines interaction boundary
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual named/connected external hardware

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Composition member exposure and source attribution
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Module is functional architectural entity realizable in hardware and/or software elements
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not automatically a discoverable child resource or observation attribution

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported physical parent/child attachment relationships
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: System may be nested and Pod may hold elements from several SOSA sensors
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No measured installation or fixed cardinality

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Persistent System identifier
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Native System is defined by capability and contextual composition
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No persistent unique System ID established by native definition

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared component capability catalogue
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Capability represents tasks or assignments possible given current health/configuration
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Not a reported machine-readable capabilities catalogue

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component capability and readiness report
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Capabilities depend on current condition, Health comprises status faults and warnings
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual status or readiness message

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Required and recommended capability support
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Conformance means complete adherence whereas Compliance means degree and verification checks adherence
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Glossary does not impose DIM Profile SHALLs or certify equipment

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Supported operating mode
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Mode is finite discrete condition with expected behavior for system module or equipment
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No identified set of modes on source-case equipment

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared default mode
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Source Mode definition says discrete finite behavior
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Does not define default mode

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-reported operating mode
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Mode is behavioral condition separate from Status performance and health
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No reported current operating mode

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported component operating condition
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Health aggregates status/faults/warnings; Status is performance/health condition; State top-level lifecycle
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: These distinct concepts must not be collapsed into one status field

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component property-value report
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Status is condition, Configuration is operational setup
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No specific observed property-value message

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Four-valued evaluation state
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: State is top-level lifecycle condition
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No native four-value ISA state enumeration

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Requested latest occurrence of an operating-state code
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Logging persistently captures lifecycle state
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No latest-occurrence query or time-keyed request

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Requested time-keyed operating-state history
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Logging stores modes and states for later retrieval
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No standardized history query or timestamp key

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Component configuration version
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Configuration describes how sensor/module is set up
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No revision field or current version identified

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Requested current component configuration message
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Glossary defines operational setup
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No network-accessible query/request API

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command interface
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Task comes from outside sensor; Assignment is internal; management and request-response support functions
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No approved CSAPI Command endpoint/schema

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Issued control request
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Origin distinguishes external Task from internal Assignment
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No actual issued request or tasking authorization

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Command acknowledgement / reported outcome
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Service acts on client request then responds
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No async acknowledgement or current execution evidence

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command parameter
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Source describes request-response interaction pattern
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No typed command parameters or source schema

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Declared command result
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Source describes response message after service acts
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No accepted common result schema

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Service role and required command support
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Sensor Management functions implemented by System Manager and Task Manager modules/interfaces
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No universal common CSAPI command role or service set

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported output field
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Raw/minimal Data Products differ from processed/reduced Information Products
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: Neither guarantees digital ObservedProperty or named output field

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Observed / observable property
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Sensor estimates properties of external entities and generates quantitative data
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No exact OGC ObservedProperty identity or vocabulary

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Performed Observation
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Sensor estimates properties and Detection is observation distinguished from background
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No current observed event or time-stamped result

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported value and associated uncertainty
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Native Sensor produces quantitative data
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No uncertainty quantity/unit in this definition

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Original event and derived digital representation (proposed DIM)
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Detection and raw/processed outputs reflect different native phenomena and processing stages
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No owner approval to merge event with derived representation

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Source-qualified event identity and reference
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Audit Event is module-produced loggable event while Notification reports occurrence
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No event ID URI or source reference

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Event occurrence time
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Native Notification reports event at occurrence
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No timestamp/clock basis in definition

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Event creation category
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Detection and Audit Event are semantically different event types
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No accepted common category enumeration

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: Reported primary event-generation method
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Detection is an observation differentiated from background
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.negative_equivalence_boundary: No defined triggering algorithm/method

source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.label: REVIEW HOLD — reporting path
source_qualified_existing_row_mappings.native_source_meaning: Notifications report events; audit events can be filtered relayed collected for storage
